description: Clean up old outputs and organize agent-orchestrator directory

tasks.prompt:
Analyze /home/opsvi/master_root/apps/agent-orchestrator directory and identify cleanup targets.

FOCUS ON:
1. Old workflow outputs in output/ directory (keep only last 7 days)
2. Temporary files and abandoned experiments
3. Duplicate or obsolete files
4. Misplaced files that should be reorganized

CREATE:
- List of directories/files to archive (old outputs)
- List of files to delete (temp/obsolete)
- List of files to reorganize

Be conservative - preserve anything that might be important.

Create a safe cleanup script for the agent-orchestrator directory.

BASED ON ANALYSIS: Use the cleanup targets identified.

SCRIPT REQUIREMENTS:
1. Create backup first (tar archive of current state)
2. Archive old outputs (older than 7 days) to output/archive/
3. Remove only clearly obsolete files
4. Add --dry-run option to preview changes
5. Log all actions taken

Create cleanup.py script that:
- Has safety checks
- Shows what will be done
- Asks for confirmation
- Can be reversed

Execute the cleanup of agent-orchestrator directory.

STEPS:
1. Run cleanup script in dry-run mode first
2. Review what will be changed
3. Create backup archive
4. Execute actual cleanup
5. Verify orchestrator still works
6. Document changes made

PRIORITIES:
- Archive old workflow outputs
- Remove clearly obsolete files only
- Preserve all core functionality
- Keep recent work (last 7 days)
